papers.title_en: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
papers.authors: Guo Gan, Yilun Zhao, Cong Chen, Jinbiao Wei, Tingyu Song, Zheyuan Yang, Lin Fu, Hong Zhou
papers.evidence: 在运行时异常下评估Android GUI智能体，直接相关移动智能体评估与挑战
papers.tldr: 现有Android GUI代理基准缺乏对运行时异常的鲁棒性评估。我们提出AnTrap基准，通过四层十类动态扰动注入执行轨迹，并保证任务可解。测试16个模型发现普遍脆弱，最强模型也显著降级。GRPO训练显示状态与动作层的单步陷阱可缓解，但状态死锁等深层上下文陷阱暴露固有限制。
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. Furthermore, we conduct GRPO training in both original and adversarial environments to validate our benchmark, separating environment-learnable anomalies from reasoning-bottlenecked ones. Our findings show that while single-step traps at state and action layers are largely addressable through adversarial reinforcement learning, deep contextual traps, like state deadlock, expose intrinsic limitations that cannot be resolved by training in environments with traps alone.

papers.title_en: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents
papers.authors: AIMAE Team, Tianxiang Chen, Yan Cheng, Zhangye Han, Xiaowei Li, Chang Liu, Cheng Liu, Zhongqiang Ma, Long Peng, Xiaobing Tu, Yinggui Wang, Hongliang Wei, Chen Wu, Daiping Xin, Kunyu Zhou, Pengyang Zhou, Peiyuan Chen, Ziyuan Chen, Yutao Deng, Chunyu Dong, Xiangyu Fu, Yicheng Feng, Ruian He, Haochen Li, Miancan Liu, Zhengqin Liu, Wei Peng, Jinkui Ren, Haoyu Tan, Dong Xiao, Rongkun Xue, Shujian Yang, Xianhang Ye, Ziqi Yuan, Ziyang Yu, Linghan Zhang, Xiantao Zhang, Xuanpu Zhao, Yinan Zhao, Zhenghui Zhao, Bin Zhu, Likai Zou
papers.evidence: 提出面向真实世界长时程任务的智能体框架，处理错误恢复与复杂UI等部署挑战，可迁移至移动端任务自动化
papers.tldr: 现有浏览器智能体在短、干净的演示任务上表现良好，但真实部署场景下面临长时决策、错误恢复和复杂界面等严峻挑战。为此提出Wuying-Browser-Agent统一框架，从执行、监督、优化、评估四个层面进行系统性对齐：结构化浏览器工具提供稳定执行原语，RUIC-SFT专门训练恢复轨迹与复杂界面交互，DAO-GRPO采用潜在奖励塑形与散度感知加权优化长时信用分配，并构建长时基准BrowserBench。该27B模型在三大基准上刷新开源SOTA，且同管线能迁移至通用智能体任务，充分证明系统级对齐比单纯扩大规模更加有效。
papers.abstract_en: Browser agents perform well on short, clean demonstrations, but real deployment is fundamentally different: agents must sustain dozens of decisions on live websites while recovering from mistakes and navigating complex UIs. We argue that closing this gap requires alignment at every level of the pipeline, including execution, supervision, optimization, and evaluation, rather than scale alone. We present Wuying-Browser-Agent, a unified framework that addresses each of these levels. A structured browser harness provides stable execution primitives and decision-oriented context management. Reflection and UI-specialized Curriculum SFT (RUIC-SFT) explicitly trains on recovery trajectories and complex-UI interactions. Divergence-Aware Online GRPO (DAO-GRPO) improves long-horizon credit assignment through potential-based reward shaping and divergence-aware step weighting. Finally, we introduce BrowserBench, a bilingual real-web benchmark of 350 tasks averaging 37.9 steps, because most existing benchmarks are too short to expose long-horizon failure modes. Wuying-Browser-Agent-27B achieves 80.6\% on WebVoyager, 66.7\% on Online-Mind2Web, and 65.1\% on BrowserBench, establishing a new open-source state of the art on browser-use benchmarks. The same pipeline also transfers beyond browser use, demonstrating strong general agentic ability and reaching an average score of 73.8 on Tau2-Bench, Claw-Eval, and BFCL-v4.

papers.title_en: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents
papers.evidence: 针对可执行智能体的超权错误，这一挑战同样存在于移动任务自动化智能体部署中
papers.tldr: 工具型LLM代理常行使超出任务所需的权限，传统权限门控不足以应对。本文提出任务条件化最小权限后训练框架，通过六维风险审计与充分权限包络计算轨迹过度权限值并优化。在Qwen3.5-4B上训练后，安全成功率由64.36%提升至98.48%，过度权限错误由4.56%降至0.79%。该方法可作为额外控制层，但无法替代权限门控与沙箱。
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language-model agents can complete a task while exercising authority that the user did not grant or the task does not need, causing excess-authority errors. Traditional permission gating systems alone for validating agent environments are insufficient. We study whether post-training can teach a 4B-parameter model to choose task-conditioned authority in executable terminal and Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments to complement those measures. We propose a framework where each action is audited before execution and again from observed effects along six dimensions of risk. This auditing is conducted using deterministic verifiers that score completion, evidence, exact state, prohibited attempts, and safe success. In conjunction with predefined task-specific sufficient-authority envelopes, we determine task-specific excess privilege values for trajectories, which are then optimized for in post-training. We find that after training using this framework on Qwen3.5-4B over 1,500 tasks, the selected seed reaches 98.48% safe success across 2,896 evaluation episodes spanning all 500 held-out tasks, compared with 64.36% for the base policy, and reduces excess-authority error events from 4.56% to 0.79%. Furthermore, external tests show capability retention and prompt-directed improvement. A 400 task continuation study also found evidence of generalization, reducing excess-authority events by 6.99 percentage points while maintaining previous capabilities. We conclude learned restraint through least-privilege aware post-training is therefore useful as an additional control layer for tool-using agents in executable terminal and MCP environments, but it does not replace permission gates and sandboxing.

papers.title_en: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces
papers.authors: Yucheng Jiang, Zora Zhiruo Wang, Ruishi Chen, Diyi Yang
papers.evidence: 从计算机使用轨迹中发现任务模型，可迁移至移动端任务执行学习
papers.tldr: 现实中的计算机使用trace仅含低层截图与按键，且多任务并发交织，现有方法多假设给定任务或单一工作流，只能产出步骤级摘要，难以形成结构化任务模型。为此提出TMI：先自动发现潜在任务、解开并发活动，再为每个任务诱导层级目标模型与程序控制流模型。在受控人类与智能体轨迹上，TMI恢复交织任务与真值分组的一致率达0.974，重构74.9%执行步骤；用其模型派生的技能使保留任务准确率提升30.0%，远超最强基线。该方法让从无约束轨迹中提取可审计、可复用的任务知识成为可能。
papers.abstract_en: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks are actually performed, and organizations need to audit and reuse that knowledge. However, inducing such task models is challenging, as activity is observed only as low-level events and real-world work is multi-threaded with interleaved goals. Existing methods assume a given task or a single workflow, and produce step-level summaries rather than structured task models. We introduce Task Model Induction (TMI), which (i) discovers the latent tasks in an unconstrained trace, disentangling concurrent activity, and (ii) for each latent task, induces a task model pairing a hierarchical objective model of recursive goal decomposition with a procedure model of the control flow that organized the execution. Intrinsically, on controlled human and agent trajectories, TMI recovers interleaved tasks with 0.974 agreement against ground-truth groupings and reconstructs 74.9% of the observed execution steps, far more than the strongest workflow induction baseline. Extrinsically, skills derived from TMI's task models improve held-out task accuracy by 30.0% over the strongest baseline.

papers.title_en: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents
papers.authors: Wenhao Wu, Menghao Zhang, Xin Wang, Zhi Wang, Kun Shao, Jian Luan
papers.evidence: 面向用户终端设备的LLM智能体一致性与边界感知问题，直接相关移动任务自动化挑战
papers.tldr: 面向用户产品的LLM代理不仅需要任务解决能力，更需保持一致性和限制意识，但前沿模型在车载助手场景中重复试验表现不一致，且难以判断请求能否安全完成。为此提出TRACE自进化技能库，通过多轮评估后对比成功与失败轨迹，迭代优化每个技能的工具使用规则与行为指南，无需修改模型权重。在GPT-5.5上，Pass^3从59.9%提升至94.5%，潜在与可靠性能差距缩小至仅4.0点；隐藏集使用GPT-5.6-Sol取得第一名。该方法将模型潜在能力转化为稳定性能，提升可靠部署。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhering to domain policies. Even frontier models show a substantial gap between what they can solve at least once (Pass@3) and what they solve consistently across trials (Pass^k). We bridge this gap with TRACE (TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution), which iteratively improves a skill-based agent's behavioral knowledge without modifying model weights. This knowledge is organized as a Skill Bank of modular, retrievable skills, each encoding a self-contained set of tool-use rules and behavioral guidelines. TRACE evolves this bank through an agentic self-evolution loop: after each evaluation round, it groups trajectories by the skills invoked and refines each skill by contrasting successful and failed behaviors. The updated bank then guides subsequent rounds, while during deployment the Actor performs state-conditioned skill orchestration at every turn. On GPT-5.5, TRACE improves consistency (Pass^3) by 34.6 points, from 59.9% to 94.5%, while shrinking the gap between potential and reliable performance to just 4.0 points. On the official hidden set, TRACE achieved first place using GPT-5.6-Sol, attaining a Pass^3 score of 70%-a 40% relative improvement over the baseline. These results show that TRACE converts high model potential into stable, consistent performance gain. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE.

papers.title_en: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
papers.authors: Sungho Park, Wonjoong Kim, Rongyuan Tan, Jue Zhang, Wook-Shin Han, Pengfei Gao, Chanyoung Park, Yongqiang Yao, Rao Fu, Elsie Nallipogu, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
papers.evidence: 自动框架优化提升LLM代理在长程任务中的可靠性，相关于移动任务自动化挑战
papers.tldr: LLM代理在长时任务中因局部错误累积而不可靠，外部鞍座可提升鲁棒性，但其设计仍依赖昂贵的人工搜索。AutoSaddler将鞍座改进形式化为离线学习，基于失败轨迹诊断生成结构化代码补丁，并通过验证选择进行泛化感知的迭代更新。在GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro和Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别提升9.0、9.6和10.0个百分点。消融实验表明，深度调试、定向修改与泛化感知选择缺一不可，为自动优化代理系统提供了有效路径。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. We propose AutoSaddler, an automatic harness optimization framework that formulates harness improvement as an offline learning problem and iteratively updates the harness using failure signals from mini-batches. AutoSaddler combines failure-trace diagnosis, structured patch generation that treats the harness as code, and validation-based update selection. Experiments on GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that AutoSaddler substantially improves agent performance over the corresponding base harnesses, achieving gains of 9.0, 9.6, and 10.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further suggest that effective harness optimization benefits from three ingredients: deep debugging rather than shallow reflection, targeted modifications rather than unconstrained editing, and generalization-aware selection rather than trajectory-specific repair. Together, these results suggest that automatic harness optimization is a promising path toward more performant and reliable agent systems.

papers.title_en: Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents
papers.evidence: 关注LLM智能体工具可操作性与接口设计，可迁移至移动应用自动化
papers.tldr: 工具调用虽有效，但外部效应已提交而响应丢失时，智能体可能无法区分已提交与未提交状态，导致无法决定后续动作，即可调用性不等于可操作性。为此提出Agent-First Tooling机制集合，涵盖能力发现、执行生命周期、外部效应语义等接口干预。通过固定任务、后端、注入失败和模型、仅改变接口的AFT-Bench框架，系统揭示接口设计对智能体操作鲁棒性的关键影响。
papers.abstract_en: A tool call can be perfectly valid yet still leave an autonomous agent unable to determine what to do next. For example, if an external effect commits but its response is lost, committed and uncommitted states may become indistinguishable to the agent even though they require different continuation actions. We study this gap between callability and operability: whether a tool interface exposes the action-relevant state and semantics needed for an agent to continue safely under operational uncertainty. We operationalize tool operability through Agent-First Tooling (AFT), a set of interface mechanisms spanning selective capability discovery, execution lifecycle and recovery, explicit external-effect semantics, machine-readable results, and postcondition verification. We introduce AFT-Bench, a controlled interface-intervention framework that holds the task, backend, initial state, injected failure, agent, and language model fixed while varying the interface exposed to the agent.
